findings.title: Unbounded dict-key scan precedes cheap container budget refusal
findings.evidence: bound performs all(type(k) is str for k in value) across the entire supplied dict before charging len(value) framing and before a node-count/container-size refusal. An already supplied arbitrarily large dict can force work far beyond the stated1M-node bound even when its framing is immediately over64MiB. Serialization/deepcopy bounds otherwise occur early.
